basis: Untransformed Psi export axes. The capture uses a spatial anchor; its physical room origin and head-relative pose have not been independently calibrated for this recording.

clock.sync: Right_sync.txt column 0, on the publisher RGB-aligned recording clock in seconds
clock.sensor: Right_sync.txt column 1, integer 100 ns ticks relative to the first source row; repeated ticks may label successive sync rows
clock.firstTickOrigin: First right-hand file row; elapsed sensor time may differ from RGB time.
clock.timingLimit: Action labels are video-relative. No extra latency correction or independent exposure-to-hand calibration was applied.

provenance.creator: HoloAssist, Xin Wang, Taein Kwon and colleagues (ICCV 2023)
provenance.dataUse: Retrospective action descriptions and HoloLens 2 joint-position estimates. This is a training example.
